HeritageSiteDoc.title: HeritageSiteDoc
HeritageSiteDoc.description: Lightweight metadata, high-resolution photo URLs, captions, and editorial overrides for each of the 17 heritage monuments.

photos.description: Primary and secondary high-resolution photo URLs

SiteModelDoc.title: SiteModelDoc
SiteModelDoc.description: 3D model cloud reference (CDN URL or chunked DB pointer), transform calibration, explosion dissection settings, and hotspots.

SiteAudioDoc.title: SiteAudioDoc
SiteAudioDoc.description: Audio narration cloud reference (.m4a/.mp3 CDN URL or chunked DB pointer), duration metadata, and script overrides.

CloudAssetMetaDoc.title: CloudAssetMetaDoc
CloudAssetMetaDoc.description: Metadata manifest for a chunked 3D model (.glb), audio narration (.m4a/.mp3), uploaded image, or short video (<=25MB) stored across 350KB Base64 chunks.

CloudAssetChunkDoc.title: CloudAssetChunkDoc
CloudAssetChunkDoc.description: Fixed 350KB Base64 slice belonging to a chunked binary asset (3D, audio, image, or video up to 25MB/file on Firebase free tier).

SiteVideoDoc.title: SiteVideoDoc
SiteVideoDoc.description: External YouTube/Vimeo/CDN video links and chunked local video references per heritage monument.

SyncStateDoc.title: SyncStateDoc
SyncStateDoc.description: Unified cross-device sync snapshots (accounts registry, global config, visitor reviews, quizzes, and lastGlobalSyncAt marker).

HealthCheckProbeDoc.title: HealthCheckProbeDoc
HealthCheckProbeDoc.description: Lightweight read/write verification probe for Admin Studio Firebase health checks.

MediaCreditsChunk.title: MediaCreditsChunk
MediaCreditsChunk.description: Chunked archival media credits & copyright citations (max 35 items per document).

GlobalSettingsDoc.title: GlobalSettingsDoc
GlobalSettingsDoc.description: Global site configuration, visibility toggles, and baked asset schema version.

CloudSyncManifest.title: CloudSyncManifest
CloudSyncManifest.description: Master timestamp marker for Local vs Cloud conflict comparison.

AdminAccount.title: AdminAccount
AdminAccount.description: Authorized curator and administrator registry keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/heritage_sites/{siteId}.description: Publicly readable heritage monument catalog metadata; admin-only write.

/site_models/{siteId}.description: Publicly readable 3D model references and calibration settings; admin-only write.

/site_audio/{siteId}.description: Publicly readable audio narration references and script overrides; admin-only write.

/site_videos/{siteId}.description: Publicly readable documentary video links & chunked video metadata; admin-only write.

/sync_state/{docId}.description: Unified cross-device sync snapshots (accounts, globalConfig, reviews); admin-only write.

/cloud_assets_meta/{docId}.description: Publicly readable chunked binary asset metadata manifests (models, audio, images, videos); admin-only write.

/cloud_assets_chunks/{docId}.description: Publicly readable 350KB Base64 binary chunks for 3D models, narrations, images & videos; admin-only write.

/_healthCheck/{docId}.description: Publicly readable health check probe; admin-only write to verify Rules & DB connectivity.

/media_credits/{chunkId}.description: Publicly readable chunked archival citations; admin-only write.

/global_settings/{docId}.description: Publicly readable global banner & visibility settings; admin-only write.

/heritage_cloud_sync/{docId}.description: Publicly readable cloud sync version manifest; admin-only write.

/admins/{uid}.description: Admin role registry; owner or admin read, admin-only write.
